messages:
alex: opened PR #4932 to revise the hello-sprint quickstart: streamline auth, add a tiny Docker deploy example, and update sample repo links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4932

rachel: thanks. main ask: can we drop the full PKCE flow from the main quickstart and point to a migration appendix? keeps first-run light.

alex: yep, main guide now shows ephemeral client tokens for demo, and a short "When to use PKCE" appendix with an excerpt and link to the full sample.

duy: CI linkcheck failed: samples/hello-sprint -> moved to samples/hello-sprint-examples.

ci-bot: build failed — docs/linkcheck — 1 broken link: /samples/hello-sprint -> 404

alex: updated the sample path and added a note recommending pinning the sample commit SHA in docs.

kelly: small consistency nit: the Docker snippet uses REDWOOD_API_TOKEN but our JS SDK examples reference REDWOOD_TOKEN. choose one?

rachel: prefer REDWOOD_TOKEN (shorter), but add a compatibility note mapping old env names for anyone on older stacks.

alex: switched to REDWOOD_TOKEN, added a tiny envvars table explaining legacy names and scopes.

duy: added a local-dev CORS troubleshooting tip (curl example) since new users hit this often.

alex: included the curl snippet and a single-line `Docker` build suggestion: `docker build --build-arg NODE_ENV=production -t hello-sprint .`.

ci-bot: linkcheck OK; docs/lint warnings: docs/quickstart-hello-sprint.md:line 38 sentence length.

kelly: editorial: change "production-ready by default" to "recommended for demo and staging" to avoid policy phrasing.

alex: updated language and pushed a smaller commit. requested reviews from @rachel and @duy.

rachel: approved. :thumbsup: also asked to add a 3-bullet migration checklist for teams moving from PKCE to ephemeral: server exchange pattern, refresh cadence, and scope equivalence notes.

alex: added the migration bullets under the appendix and linked to samples/hello-sprint-examples token-exchange file. merging after CI.

ci-bot: merged PR #4932 by alex (commit def456) into main.

alex: follow-up plan: open a docs-only PR to update the samples repo README with recommended env var names and a short compatibility table. will backport a small note to release-2.x. Thanks all!
